comparison.objective: Infer and hand-write the winning tic-tac-toe glyph, then hang and release the marker; candidate breaks and recovers HELICOIL tangs.
comparison.physical_skill: Visual game reasoning, spring-nib contact writing, trajectory control, and tool rehanging versus recessed coaxial alignment, hammer impact, and tiny-fragment pickup.
comparison.success_condition: Correct glyph confined to the winning cell, marker hung, released, and still for one second versus four safe fractures, four tangs in a tray, tools released, and two-second stability.
comparison.reason: Controlled marking and symbolic reasoning do not test fracture mechanics or retained-insert protection; shared tool release is generic.
